name: BDC_LOINC_CODES
description: This table contains LOINC code and mapping information that will help identify documentations needed from loading a 277 RF(A)I message.

columns.name: BDC_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the den/corr rec record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: LOINC_CODE
columns.description: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC�) code loaded from an ANSI 277 Request for Information(RFI) message that indicates what information was requested.
